notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics company building an AI-first in-app product assistant + document/FAQ search. Completed 30-day Hosted API trial; moving toward Dedicated for predictable latency and isolation. Key ask: realistic Dedicated capacity estimate based on observed Hosted metrics and expected growth.

Hosted POC findings (high-level):
- Trial period: 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-10 (pilot across 3 product teams: search, assistant, recommendations).
- Observed average steady QPS: ~18 qps during business hours (NA), baseline concurrency ~12.
- Peak observed QPS (spikes during launches): 85 qps (short bursts), peak concurrency measured: 48.
- Token mix (observed): ~60% short prompts (<128 tokens), ~30% medium (128-512), ~10% long (>512). Avg token length: ~210 tokens/request.
- Latency targets: p95 <= 350ms for assistant short-turns; p95 <= 800ms for long-run retrieval+rerank flows.
- Cost sensitivity: wants to reduce per-token $ by 30-50% vs hosted plan; prefers predictable reserved pricing.

Requirements discussed:
- Must support SSO + audit logs + KMS integration; data residency: US only for now.
- Routing: primary region NA, fallback EU for DR.
- Model preferences: open-model variants ok (higher quantized), but want Redwood-recommended quant profiles and fallback policy.

Technical notes / quotes: 
- "If we can guarantee p95 under 400ms for our core assistant with reserved capacity, we'll pull the trigger." — Head of Product (L. Kim).
- SE note: initial autoscale policy needs warm pool for 40 concurrent KV caches; recommend burst pool for marketing spikes.

Recent timeline / activity (CRM style):
- 2026-02-11: Hosted trial onboarding call (owner: Arielle P., SE Diego M.). Fireflies: ff_20260218_8b7c2f.
- 2026-02-24: Mid-trial check-in, shared latency/cost dashboard, recommended batching tweaks.
- 2026-03-01: Demo of canary routing + prefix caching (Gmail thread: thread-CPXl3k_20260301).
- 2026-03-08: Security deep-dive with infra + security team; submitted partial security questionnaire.
- 2026-03-10: Final Hosted trial wrap; provided raw telemetry export and suggested Dedicated sizing template.

Dedicated sizing assumptions (proposal inputs):
- Target steady-state qps: 30 qps (expected 3x baseline after wider rollout).
- Estimated peak concurrency: 180 (accounting for 3x baseline spikes + marketing events).
- Token mix for sizing: short 55%, medium 30%, long 15%. Expected avg token/request: 260.
- Desired SLOs: p95 <= 350ms for short flows, overall availability 99.95.
- KVs and cache: require hot-KV cache capacity for 1.2M keys; suggests pre-warmed LPUs for latency-sensitive routes.

Pricing / commercial notes:
- Interested in 12-month committed Dedicated contract with burst credits. Target ARR band $120k-$230k.
- Procurement ask: line-item for KMS integration + extra observability retention (30-day logs).

Open questions for Redwood sales/engineering:
- Final mapping from observed Hosted telemetry to GPU pool sizing (N x gpus of A100/ H100 equivalents).
- Recommended autoscale policy for mixed workload (low-latency assistant + batch reranking).
- Confirmation of quantization profile impact on latency for medium-long tokens.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to deliver Dedicated sizing worksheet + priced proposal by 2026-03-20.
- Schedule 60-min capacity design review (SE + infra + Sunerra infra) w/c 2026-03-22.
- Sunerra to complete security questionnaire + procurement timeline (target decision by 2026-05).

CRM notes (shorthand):
- Good PM buy-in, Eng champion = backend lead (R. Patel). Budget owned by VP Eng. Legal wants standard SOC2 attestation + CNDA.
- Risk: procurement window Q2; if pricing not compelling, may evaluate cloud offerings (competitive slack).
